failure_reason: Site-wide Cloudflare managed challenge (HTTP 403, response header 'cf-mitigated: challenge', 'server: cloudflare', body = interstitial titled 'Un instant...'/'Just a moment...'). NOT a per-path or transient block: 72/72 probes returned 403 across 12 paths x 4 TLS fingerprints x 3 rounds spaced 90s apart (sample cf-ray a25b1e713de590b5-IXC). Paths tried, all 403: /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml, /sitemaps/sitemap-index.xml, /, /c/maison, /c/maison-decoration-objet+deco-vase, /c/maison-arts+de+la+table-verre-verre+a+vin, /c/maison-luminaire, /graphql, /api/graphql, /_nuxt/graphql.20a95c2d.js. Clients tried, all 403: python-requests (Chrome 131 UA), curl_cffi TLS impersonation (chrome131 / chrome124 / chrome120 / safari18_0 / firefox135), Googlebot and curl/8.4.0 user-agents, and the harness probe.py. Real-browser attempts all served the same interstitial and never cleared it (40 x 2s waits per try): Playwright bundled Chromium headless and headed, playwright-stealth 2.0.3 with persistent context, and patchright 1.61.2 driving locally-installed Google Chrome (headless); headed real Chrome could not start (no interactive desktop session). WebFetch also returned HTTP 403. Different-egress fetch proxies also blocked: r.jina.ai returned the same Cloudflare interstitial, corsproxy.io requires a paid key, api.allorigins.win returned 522. No bypass host exists: m./api./mobile./shop./search..bhv.fr are all NXDOMAIN, apex bhv.fr 301s to www.bhv.fr, and the site's own runtime config (recovered from an archived page) shows the storefront BFF is cluster-internal only - config.api.bff.hostname = 'ggl-bff-bhv.bhv.svc.cluster.local', config.context.hostname.client = 'https://www.bhv.fr' - so every catalogue call is proxied through the blocked www host. No third-party search index (Algolia / Searchspring / Constructor.io / Bloomreach) is used; the front end is Nuxt + internal GraphQL. Consequently no live listing page and no exact 'N Produits' total could be read for any sub-category. Only stale Wayback Machine snapshots (2024-2025) were reachable, which cannot supply a current exact qty, and no qty was taken from them. No rows emitted rather than record unverified numbers.
notes: Correct live locale confirmed: https://www.bhv.fr/ (apex bhv.fr 301-redirects to www.bhv.fr; single French locale, no country selector). The Maison department URL scheme was recovered from the Wayback CDX index (all URLs below returned HTTP 200 when archived) and is recorded here purely as a retry map for a session with browser/residential-proxy access - NO quantities were extracted, so no rows are emitted. Pattern: https://www.bhv.fr/c/maison-<dept>-<group>-<subcategory> (spaces encoded as '+'); /fc/ = colour filter, /fm/ = brand filter, /fmat/ = material filter, /ftai/ = size filter, /p:N = pagination - none of these are categories. Qualifying decor branches to target on retry: Arts de la table -> vaisselle (assiette plate, assiette creuse, assiette a dessert, assiette a pates et pizza, assiette de presentation, bol, mug, tasse, service de vaisselle, coquetier), verre (verre a vin, verre a eau, verre a biere, verre a cocktail, verre a aperitif, verre a liqueur, flute a champagne, coupe a glace, verrine en verre, service complet verre), carafe, accessoires de table (saladier, plateau de service, dessous de plat, corbeille a pain et a fruits, beurrier, saucier, decoration de table), service a the et cafe (theiere, accessoires the et cafe), autour du vin (carafe a decanter, seau a glace, shaker cocktail). Luminaire -> suspension et plafonnier (suspension, suspension design, suspension led, lustre, plafonnier), lampe (lampe a poser, lampe de chevet, lampe de bureau, lampe design, lampe classique, abat jour, pied de lampe), applique (applique murale, applique design, applique led, applique tableau), lampadaire, liseuse, spoterie, luminaire d'exterieur (lanterne exterieur, applique d'exterieur, lampadaire exterieur). Decoration -> objet deco (vase, bougeoir, photophore et lanterne, objets decoratifs, plante et fleur, panier et corbeille, cloches et accessoires), decoration murale (miroir, cadre, cadre photo, image et affiche, elements decoratifs muraux, objet mural, pele mele), bougie et parfum d'interieur (bougie, diffuseurs a tiges, diffuseurs electriques, brules parfum, ceramiques parfumees, spray d'ambiance, huiles essentielles, recharge pour diffuseur, concentres de parfum), decoration lumineuse (guirlande lumineuse, bougie lumineuse, decoration lumineuse).
